items.content:
Earlier gameplay summary (agent-written, uncertain claims remain uncertain):
LEARNED NOTES (observed unless marked guess/uncertain).
CONTROLS: WASD move; arrow keys fire; move+fire works. E drops bomb at feet (~1s fuse, self-damage; warping does not outrun blast). Space/Q no observed effect. Mural in start room displays control hints. Empty heart outlines + blood splatter = death; death respawns in start room (mural room) full health with key 01.
WARP/HATCH: requires near-exact centering on the visible frame, then sustained walk into it (~1.0-1.2s) from ~0.1-0.2 units away. Standing on the frame blocks warping; back off, re-center, retry; multiple tries normal. Frame center may differ from room center — align to the frame (torch-room gold hatch center observed ~x0.485, not 0.50). Diagonal/sideways entry along top row has worked; whether diagonal is strictly required is unresolved (guess: only y-alignment matters). Doorways have y-windows, e.g. start room right ornate door at y~0.40-0.55, x~0.78-0.82.
TECH X: entering the two-poop room auto-grants Tech X (laser-ring Tears), confirmed twice. Firing produces a red squiggly laser ring lingering ~1s at a fixed offset along my row/column. Rocks block lasers and are not destroyed. Kills white-faced chasers at range but they close fast; must aim exactly on row/column. Red ring is my own attack, not a lock/telegraph (uncertain).
ROUTE/MAP: Start/mural room: top dark hatch <-> rock field; bottom dark hatch <-> torch room; right-wall ornate doorway <-> dark chest room. Rock field: bottom hatch <-> start; top hatch <-> TNT room; left-wall gold/ornate door ~x0.19-0.20, y~0.44-0.48. Torch room: top hatch <-> start; gold bottom-center hatch <-> two-poop room (approach centered from ~0.1-0.15 above). Two-poop room: only exit is top crown/gold hatch x~0.50, y~0.09-0.17, approached from ~0.1 below; standing on frame blocks. TNT room: top dark hatch <-> pink-enemy rock room; bottom hatch <-> rock field; TNT barrels inert, line left wall/mid-room, block movement, don't shoot point-blank; red-lidded brown barrels near left wall (guess key-locked); bomb-holding walker mid-room survived ~5-6 vertical tear volleys with no visible reaction — armor/hitbox unclear, treat as dangerous; left-wall gray plates inert decor.
HAZARDS: Rock field is severe: white-faced chasers (fast, transform into winged forms or spiked black ring with gray enemy center), green glowing blobs that expand and burst over large areas dealing damage on contact, blue-tear shooters, spiky pellets/wheels. Repeated hits land faster than warp setup; hits can occur in doorway frames. At 1.5 hearts any contact can be fatal — flee through a hatch rather than fight; don't loiter in rock field. Torch room: center column rock-choked; safe left lane x~0.31-0.42 full height, right lane x~0.63 traversable; center gray chest sealed by indestructible rocks — ABANDON; corner torches (~0.25/0.75, y0.25/0.77) damage on touch; small specks near left wall minor hazards. Pink-enemy rock room: two pink fat enemies left-center observed very close; rock wall ring right with three dark teardrop objects and small blue creature (uncertain); fight only at range. Dark chest room: two red-lidded unspiked chests top (~0.33,0.32),(~0.67,0.32); central spiked chest emits spikes, untouchable; small black cat-like chasers roam (~y0.50); yellow-green blob left (~0.26,0.48); repeated rapid heart drain even at full health — death trap; enter only with retreat plan and fight at range.
FAILED STRATEGIES: Pressing red-lidded chests did not clearly open/yield item. Rock-field left gold/keyhole door tested repeatedly with key 01 — pressing into it, exact vertical alignment, sustained pushes, push-while-firing-left — did not open, key not consumed; stop testing it. Bombing two-poop center rock cost a heart and broke nothing; rocks judged indestructible; never bomb at low health or adjacent to self.
CHESTS/BOMBS: Gray chests open by contact. Key counter has read 01 in runs. Coin pot breaks on contact for a coin. Poop piles harmless/regenerate.
HEALTH: Mid-fight refill seen once, mechanism uncertain. At 1/half heart any contact ends the run.
UNRESOLVED: keyhole/gold door condition; whether key opens red-lidded chests/barrels; bomb-walker armor/hitbox; heart-refill mechanism; meaning of red laser ring; cause of one-time two-poop center-rock disappearance; whether doorways strictly need diagonal entry or only y-alignment; pink-room enemy behavior/rewards. Retained goals: get Tech X early via two-poop room; safely explore pink room; find key's real use; avoid dark chest room unless well-healed.
